title: DIMSTYLE DIMTFILLCLR allocation rollback and retry
scope: Exercise generated AC1021 DIMSTYLE output with table flags, DIMTFILL, and a nondefault peer-profile DIMTFILLCLR ACI value
Exercise both typed DIMTFILLCLR state and the exact $DIMTFILLCLR dynamic override, verifying override precedence
Inject allocation failures throughout complete ASCII and Binary document writes
Verify output destination and caller DIMSTYLE state, including the dynamic override, are preserved after each failure
Retry using the same codec and adapter, compare complete output bytes with a clean baseline, and read the typed effective value back

validation.testResult: PASS (1/1; 0.62 seconds; typed and dynamic DIMTFILLCLR rollback/retry profiles)

claimBoundary: Generated transaction and same-library readback evidence only; this does not independently validate producer semantics or native CAD behavior.

The second group-70 DIMTFILLCLR mapping is an unofficial peer-documented compatibility profile; Autodesk's published DIMSTYLE DXF schema lists group 70 as table-entry flags and does not document this second occurrence.
RGB and book-color CMC states remain refused, as do third and later DIMSTYLE group-70 occurrences and nondefault downgrades to pre-AC1021 targets.
No support claim or external/platform qualification gate is promoted.
